content.value: Moist air enters a chamber at 10°C DBT and 8°C WBT at a rate of 100 cmm. While passing 11 through the chamber, the air absorbs sensible heat at the rate of 35 kW and picks up 40 kg/hr of saturated steam at 110°C. Determine the dry and wet bulb temperatures of the leaving air. Assume the barometric pressure is 1.01325 bar.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 4th Year Special Backlog Examination, 2020
